title: Sakamoto Ryouma: Ishin Kaikoku
overview:
Bring an end to the turbulent era of the Bakumatsu...
A cast of 500 characters.
More than 150 historical events.
...The course of history is now in your hands.

A historical simulation set in the final years of the shogunate, built around Sakamoto Ryoma. Grow the influence of your faction and, once it is strong enough, hold meetings to hand out tasks to your followers, from recruiting new allies to attempting to remove dangerous rivals. Your own faction can be attacked too, so take care not to draw too much attention from the shogunate as real historical events unfold around you.

- Single player
- Memory backup save
- Shuttle Mouse compatible

幕末動乱の時代に終止符を…。
登場人物総勢五百名。
歴史イベント総数百五十以上。
…歴史のゆくえは、今、あなたにゆだねられた。
